title: amusement park variation? do these dreams happen around certain life events?
content: just stumbled on this sub and am fascinated. I’ve been reading all day, there are a lot of themes I have definitely experienced. I havent had a very high frequency of these types of dreams but this one super vivid dream that I had shortly after my first kid was born sticks out and aligns with some of the accounts I’ve been reading. it was an open air version of mallworld, kind of a mix between an amusement park and a state fair/circus. it was huge with sprawling fields in between different sections of the park. to get from section to section you had to walk down these long tent lined paths of vendors with really unique games and concessions. it kind of always seemed like there were clowns just out of sight (but not in a scary way really). what really stuck out was peoples accounts of bathrooms from their dreams. mine had a major portion/scene in the bathroom that was incredibly gross with radioactive looking neon green smile everywhere & the architecture was just… strange. my son was a newborn baby in real life but in the dream he was a toddler/little kid and I was trying so hard to keep him from touching anything. like I said, I don’t have these types of vivid dreams very often but when they do show up it seems to be around big life events or when there is a lesson I need to learn.
